blocks.title: NIBP Quick Measure
blocks.text: **Measure BP** → NIBP Auto → Delay 2 seconds → NIBP Manual.\n\nReported working; verify on a second scenario.
blocks.source: Instructor-created workflow; colleague showed events in Trends.

blocks.title: PEA Transition Guard
blocks.text: When exiting PEA: explicitly set **No PEA**, not **No change**. Verify monitor and pulse states in LLEAP.

blocks.title: Media: Play / Hide / Stop
blocks.text: Immediately starts display/playback. Hidden hides visual content but is not a guaranteed audio stop. Test audio stop separately.
blocks.source: SimDesigner documentation (verify edition and current release)

blocks.title: Engineering impact
blocks.text: Record baseline clicks per cycle, automated clicks after change, number of cycles, failures, and instructor workload. Avoid translating clicks into staff savings without observations.
blocks.source: Measurement plan; no controlled study yet
